<thought>To obtain the precursors we first need the retrosynthetic template that matches the chalcone‑to‑flavanone cyclization described. I will search the template catalog using a representative flavanone SMILES and the functional‑group and bond change criteria given in the prompt. This should return the template ID, which can then be applied to the target molecule to get all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(C2=CC=CC=C2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
